validity.researcher_notes: route_integrity flagged the last endpoint (49.526, 39.151) as landing in Ukraine when both country columns say Russia. The endpoint is correct: NOVOPSKOV IS IN LUHANSK OBLAST, UKRAINE (49°32'18"N 39°06'07"E), confirmed by Nominatim reverse geocoding and by the English Wikipedia article. VTG corroborates internally — its own «Оренбург-Новопсков» row lists the countries as «Россия, Украина», i.e. the institute treats Novopskov as the Ukrainian end of a cross-border line. (VTG's grouped Северный Кавказ-Центр country cell reads «Россия» alone; that is an aggregate imprecision over a multi-line group, not a contradiction.) Note the row is in the Ukraine scope precisely because of this, and that Luhansk Oblast is occupied — which is a control question, not a sovereignty one, and does not change the country columns.
